_comment: Commercial counterparties attached to pricing/availability/deployment offers. Upserted by slug. type uses provider_type enum verbatim. manufacturer_slug links an OEM provider to its manufacturer.

providers.name: 1X Technologies (direct)
providers.description: Direct OEM sales / preorder for the NEO home robot.

providers.name: Engineered Arts
providers.description: OEM sale (by quote) and event rental of Ameca.

providers.name: RobotShop EU
providers.description: Third-party multi-brand robotics retailer, not an OEM store. Listings verified per-SKU (price, availability) before use as commercial evidence.

providers.name: RobotShop US
providers.description: Third-party multi-brand robotics retailer, not an OEM store. US storefront, distinct from the EU one: it prices in USD and states tariff-inclusive pricing for the USA, so its offers must not be attached to robotshop-eu. Listings verified per-SKU (price, availability) before use as commercial evidence.

providers.name: RobotLAB
providers.description: US robotics reseller and integrator (robotlab.com), a third-party seller, not a manufacturer or an OEM store, and not stated to be an authorized distributor. Sells, leases (RaaS), deploys and services robots in the US by quote. Offers are attributed to the US only. Proposed as a provider in HO-RESEARCH-NA-02 (2026-10-23); registration needs owner approval.

providers.name: reichelt elektronik
providers.description: German electronics distributor (reichelt.com), third-party seller, not an OEM store. Offers are attributed to its German storefront (region DE); listed prices include 19% German VAT.

providers.name: QUADRUPED Robotics
providers.description: German robotics distributor (quadruped.de), third-party seller, not an OEM store. Listed prices exclude 19% VAT.

providers.name: Robotoplus
providers.description: Bulgarian robotics integrator and reseller (Роботоплюс ООД, robotoplus.com), a third-party seller, not an OEM store. States on its own site that it is AGIBOT's appointed distributor for Bulgaria and Romania and that it delivers to Bulgaria, Romania, Greece and Cyprus. That authorization is SELF-DECLARED by the distributor and has not been confirmed on an AgiBot first-party source; do not present it as an officially verified AgiBot distributor. Offers are attributed only to BG and RO (the countries named in the appointment wording).

providers.name: Alza.cz
providers.description: Czech online electronics retailer (alza.cz), a third-party seller, not a manufacturer or an OEM store. Approved as a commercial provider and as a REFERENCE source for evidence-backed offers (owner decision 2026-10-05). Offers are attributed only to its Czech storefront (region CZ, currency CZK): no Slovak, Hungarian or EU-wide offer is inferred from Alza operating in other markets. Owner-approved for recurring discovery monitoring on 2026-10-18, but monitoring is NOT yet active: no Alza price or stock is fetched or checked automatically today. Every Alza offer is a dated evidence snapshot, never a live price or live stock. New and used (bazaar) units are separate offers.

providers.name: Unitree China (direct sales)
providers.description: Unitree's own mainland-China sales channel: the Chinese-language site unitree.com/cn (tax-inclusive CNY list prices, intent-order form, 400 sales hotline) and its directly operated stores. Distinct from unitree-store (shop.unitree.com, the worldwide USD store recorded as GLOBAL). Offers are attributed to CN only. Proposed as a provider in HO-RESEARCH-ASIA-01 (2026-10-24); registration needs owner approval.

providers.name: GMO AI & Robotics (GMO ヒューマノイド.shop)
providers.description: GMO AI＆ロボティクス商事株式会社 (GMO Internet Group), Japan: sells by quotation and rents Unitree robots through gmo-humanoid.shop. A third-party seller, not the manufacturer. States that it signed a domestic authorized distributor agreement with Unitree on 2026-06-19; that authorization is SELF-DECLARED and has not been confirmed on a Unitree first-party source. Offers are attributed to JP only. Proposed as a provider in HO-RESEARCH-ASIA-01 (2026-10-24); registration needs owner approval.

providers.name: Switch Science
providers.description: 株式会社スイッチサイエンス, Japanese electronics retailer (switch-science.com), a third-party seller, not an OEM store. Handles Booster Robotics products from 2026-04-16 (its own release); not stated to be an authorized distributor. Prices are JPY including Japanese consumption tax. Offers are attributed to JP only. Proposed as a provider in HO-RESEARCH-ASIA-01 (2026-10-24); registration needs owner approval.

providers.name: Pepper for Home 2.0 rental (TENT Inc., Kauriru)
providers.description: 株式会社TENT (TENT Inc., Tokyo) operates the 'Pepper for Home 2.0' subscription-rental store on the Kauriru rental mall; SoftBank's official Pepper purchase page links to it for the home rental plan. Rental only (no purchase after rental), Japan only. Not the manufacturer. Proposed as a provider in HO-RESEARCH-ASIA-01 (2026-10-24); registration needs owner approval.

providers.name: Knoxlabs
providers.description: US online robotics reseller (knoxlabs.com), a third-party seller, not a manufacturer or OEM store; its pages describe items as supplied by the maker's reseller programme. Payment in full before supplier shipment, US freight and customs charged separately. Offers are attributed to the US only. Approved as a provider by the owner on 2026-10-31.
